coverage.Q3_peripheral_filling: Four slopes: explicit Lagrange reversion and mixed kernel derivative; all12 operator modulus observations each precision.

coverage.G4_local_distance: All20geometric points each precision using upper-half-plane asinh distance and its numerical derivatives, independently of Lorentz-acosh implementation.
coverage.G5_seams_torus_holonomy: All49torus cases each precision: Fricke trace identity and log-eigenvalue derivatives at250digits; extraa1000minimum from direct coth at600digits, no large-cuff derivative claim.
coverage.G6_twist_coarea: All30integrals each precision independently evaluated by incomplete beta; stable exact omitted-tail beta checked against analytic bound. No interval quadrature bound.
coverage.G7_twist_partition: All28Hterms each precision from translated logistic-density quadrature with tiny amplitude factored out; all101positive lattice tails checked.
coverage.G8_endpoint_matching: Both exact endpoint/winding configurations and both stationarity examples each precision using alternate half-plane distance.
coverage.G9_cusp_decoration: All27cusp matrices from independent Fraction formulas;3triangle decorations; all16torus signed lengths/weights each precision via hyperbolic eigenvalue form.
coverage.G10_boundary_shadows: All6shadows each precision from4q*integral_0^1(1-q^2x^2)^-1dx; tiny q is factored out, independent of log1p/coth evaluation.
